sn4.6:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || 2.
sn4.6:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā rattandhakāra-timisāyam ajjhokāse nisinno hoti devo ca ekam ekam phusāyati || || 3.
sn4.6:2.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā Bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ loma-haṃsam uppādetu-kāmo mahantaṃ sappa-rājavaṇṇam abhinimminitvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || || 4.
sn4.6:2.8: Seyyathāpi nāma deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatā niccharanti
sn4.6:2.10: Seyyathāpi nāma kammāra-gaggariyā dhamamānāya saddo hoti
sn4.6:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā Māro ayam pāpimā iti viditvā Māram pāpimantam gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.6:6.4: upadhīsu tānaṃ na karonti buddhā ti || || 6.
sn4.6:7.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ Bhagavā jānāti maṃ Sugato ti tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1.
